name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-rocky-wrench
title: Redrawn Styled Rocky Wrench
description:
Redrawn-styled graphics meant for the Rocky Wrench custom sprite (both Sonikku and Koyuki's versions), which come in 2 variations:

* Classic: Based on their SMB3 & Mario Kart 8 DX DLC appearance.
* Monty: Based on their look in the NSMB and Paper Mario series (ie. look like modern Monty Moles).

Each version comes with their own custom palettes due to some variations using slightly different color rows than others.

Credit's not necessary but heavily appreciated.
